hebrewText: אֵיזֶהוּ עָשִׁיר? הַשָּׂמֵחַ בְּחֶלְקוֹ
transliteration: Eizehu ashir? Hasameach b'chelko
translation: Who is rich? One who is happy with their portion.

hebrewText: אִם אֵין אֲנִי לִי מִי לִי? וּכְשֶׁאֲנִי לְעַצְמִי מָה אֲנִי? וְאִם לֹא עַכְשָׁיו אֵימָתַי
transliteration: Im ein ani li, mi li? Ukshe'ani l'atzmi, ma ani? V'im lo achshav, eimatai?
translation: If I am not for myself, who will be for me? And when I am only for myself, what am I? And if not now, when?

hebrewText: אֵיזֶהוּ חָכָם? הַלּוֹמֵד מִכָּל אָדָם
transliteration: Eizehu chacham? Halomed mikol adam
translation: Who is wise? One who learns from every person.

hebrewText: אֵיזֶהוּ גִבּוֹר? הַכּוֹבֵשׁ אֶת יִצְרוֹ
transliteration: Eizehu gibor? Hakovesh et yitzro
translation: Who is mighty? One who conquers their inclination.

hebrewText: אֵיזֶהוּ מְכֻבָּד? הַמְכַבֵּד אֶת הַבְּרִיּוֹת
transliteration: Eizehu m'chubad? Ham'chabed et hab'riyot
translation: Who is honored? One who honors others.

hebrewText: וּבְמָקוֹם שֶׁאֵין אֲנָשִׁים הִשְׁתַּדֵּל לִהְיוֹת אִישׁ
transliteration: Uv'makom she'ein anashim, hishtadel lihyot ish
translation: In a place where there are no worthy people, strive to be a person of integrity.

hebrewText: אַל תִּפְרוֹשׁ מִן הַצִּבּוּר
transliteration: Al tifros min hatzibur
translation: Do not separate yourself from the community.

hebrewText: דַּע מֵאַיִן בָּאתָ וּלְאָן אַתָּה הוֹלֵךְ
transliteration: Da me'ayin bata ul'an ata holech
translation: Know from where you came and to where you are going.

hebrewText: הֲפֹךְ בָּהּ וַהֲפֹךְ בָּהּ דְּכֹלָּא בָהּ
transliteration: Hafoch ba vahafoch ba, d'chola ba
translation: Turn it over and turn it over, for everything is in it.

hebrewText: לֹא עָלֶיךָ הַמְּלָאכָה לִגְמֹר וְלֹא אַתָּה בֶן חוֹרִין לִבָּטֵל מִמֶּנָּה
transliteration: Lo alecha ham'lacha ligmor, v'lo ata ven chorin l'hibatel mimena
translation: It is not your responsibility to finish the work, but neither are you free to desist from it.

hebrewText: עַל שְׁלֹשָׁה דְבָרִים הָעוֹלָם עוֹמֵד עַל הַתּוֹרָה וְעַל הָעֲבוֹדָה וְעַל גְּמִילוּת חֲסָדִים
transliteration: Al shlosha d'varim ha'olam omed: al haTorah, v'al ha'avoda, v'al gemilut chasadim
translation: The world stands on three things: Torah, service, and acts of kindness.

hebrewText: לֹא הַמִּדְרָשׁ הוּא הָעִקָּר אֶלָּא הַמַּעֲשֶׂה
transliteration: Lo hamidrash hu ha'ikar, ela hama'aseh
translation: Not study, but action, is the main thing.

hebrewText: לְפוּם צַעֲרָא אַגְרָא
transliteration: L'fum tza'ara agra
translation: According to the effort is the reward.

hebrewText: לֵב שָׂמֵחַ יֵיטִב גֵּהָה
transliteration: Lev sameach yeitiv geiha
translation: A joyful heart is good medicine.

hebrewText: בְּטַח אֶל ה' בְּכָל לִבֶּךָ וְאֶל בִּינָתְךָ אַל תִּשָּׁעֵן
transliteration: B'tach el Hashem b'chol libecha, v'el binatcha al tisha'en
translation: Trust in Hashem with all your heart, and do not rely on your own understanding.

hebrewText: כָּל יְמֵי עָנִי רָעִים וְטוֹב לֵב מִשְׁתֶּה תָמִיד
transliteration: Kol yemei ani ra'im, v'tov lev mishteh tamid
translation: All the days of the poor are hard, but a good heart has a continual feast.

hebrewText: גֹּל אֶל ה' מַעֲשֶׂיךָ וְיִכֹּנוּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶיךָ
transliteration: Gol el Hashem ma'asecha, v'yikonu machsh'votecha
translation: Commit your deeds to Hashem, and your plans will be established.

hebrewText: לַכֹּל זְמָן וְעֵת לְכָל חֵפֶץ תַּחַת הַשָּׁמָיִם
transliteration: Lakol z'man, v'et l'chol chefetz tachat hashamayim
translation: To everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven.

hebrewText: הַיּוֹם קָצָר וְהַמְּלָאכָה מְרֻבָּה
transliteration: Hayom katzar, v'ham'lacha m'ruba
translation: The day is short, and the work is much.

hebrewText: מַרְבֶּה תוֹרָה מַרְבֶּה חַיִּים
transliteration: Marbeh Torah, marbeh chayim
translation: More Torah, more life.
